ClotTriever® Thrombectomy System

The ClotTriever system is a mechanical thrombectomy device specifically designed for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT).

text_copy.text:
DVT patients deserve short-term results that provide great long-term outcomes.

Deep vein thrombosis (DVT) is a debilitating disease with acute symptom onset that can lead to long-term complications in 20% to 50% of patients.1

Your DVT intervention choice matters. With a well-established safety profile and effectiveness, the ClotTriever system has been studied to deliver the short and long-term outcomes interventionalists can trust.2, 3

text_1725174005.text:
Safety

Proven reliability with low serious adverse events (SAE) rates2

text_1725174005_copy.text:
Effectiveness

Consistent performance to deliver the outcomes that matter2

Evidence

Longest patient follow-up in mechanical thrombectomy2

text_copy_copy_copy__1654666376.text:
Independently adjudicated safety results

Procedural outcomes from the 500 patients enrolled in CLOUT registry demonstrate the proven safety profile of the ClotTriever System.2

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Wall-to-wall clot removal with ClotTriever removes the full range of clot chronicity

ClotTriever is the first catheter to deliver wall-to-wall clot removal to clear thrombus obstruction, allowing for valvular restoration.2

>90% Complete or near-complete thrombus removal


The ClotTriever Catheter has been studied to show complete or near-complete thrombus removal in a single session.2

text_copy_copy_copy__1925372270.text: Low rethrombosis/residual thrombus rate at 30 days3

Each vertical bar represents one category, and each bar is divided into colored segments that correspond to different PTS severity levels shown in the legend. The height of each colored segment indicates the amount or proportion of that severity level within the category, while the full height of the bar represents the total for that category. The chart is intended to help readers compare how PTS severity levels vary across categories and identify which categories have higher or lower concentrations of each severity level. Overall, the visualization emphasizes differences in severity composition rather than showing a single value for each category.

Indications for Use
 
The ClotTriever Thrombectomy System is indicated for: (1) The non-surgical removal of thrombi and emboli from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other fluids into or from a blood vessel. The ClotTriever Thrombectomy System is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature including deep vein thrombosis (DVT). The ClotTriever Sheaths are indicated for use as a conduit for the insertion of endovascular devices into the vasculature while minimizing blood loss associated with such insertions.
 
Review complete Instructions for Use, Indications for Use, Warnings, Precautions, Possible Adverse Effects and contraindications prior to use of the product.
 
For all non-Stryker products, please refer to manufacturer Instructions for Use/Intended Purpose for complete indications for use, contraindications, warnings and precautions.
 
Caution: Federal (USA) law restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician
